cohort: Neonates admitted to two high-reference neonatal intensive care units (NICU) over a 24-month period (2016-2017)
finding: The epidemiology of sepsis in two observed NICUs is comparable to data obtained from other studies with a predominance of methicillin-resistant CoNS in LO-BSI and beta-lactam resistant E. coli in EO-BSI.
